title: Shifted local Koszul comparison and normalized polynomial atlas
statement:
For a scheme morphism $f:X\to S$ and $d\geq0$, use the constant-codimension polynomial lci chart $T$ of [def-trf-lci-koszul-duality-data], with closed immersion $i:U\to P$, ambient dimension $n$, codimension $c$ and $n=c+d$. Work in the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] with their explicit universe parameters, and use the polynomial-chart exactness data [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. Define $\mathrm{ImageExact}(T)$ to be the pair of assertions that the actual module direct image for $U\to(P,i_*\mathcal O_U)$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits. It supplies exactness data and is not an assumption on every chart. The comparison $\mathrm{modelShift}$ identifies the coinduced model of $\omega[n]$ with the unshifted model shifted by $n$, using the derived functor's shift isomorphism. For supplied $h_I:\mathrm{ImageExact}(T)$, define $\mathrm{targetShift}: (i_*D[-c])[n]\simeq R i_*(D[d])$ by $n-c=d$, the standard single-complex shift isomorphisms and the exact-direct-image unit. For a supplied unshifted isomorphism $\rho$, define $\mathrm{shifted}(\rho)$ as $\mathrm{modelShift}$ followed by $\rho[n]$ followed by $\mathrm{targetShift}$. No existence or normalization of $\rho$ is asserted by this definition.

For an open immersion $j$, $\mathrm{openTensorIso}:j^*\simeq j^{\mathrm{res}}$ compares the module tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] with actual open restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same direct image. It uses the tensor adjunction selected by exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction, whose unit on sections is $m\mapsto1\otimes m$, and the native restriction adjunction.

For $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and a supplied polynomial restriction atlas $\mathcal A$ [def-trf-polynomial-duality-restriction-atlas], $\mathrm{IsNormalizedAtlas}(\mathcal A)$ means: for every pair of affine open embeddings $\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$, $\operatorname{Spec}R\to S$ over the structural map $R\to A$, there exist $M\in D(A)$, an isomorphism from $K|_{\operatorname{Spec}A}$ to the associated sheaf of $M$, and a polynomial presentation system for $M$ [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data] for which both the affine compatibility and the localized affine compatibility equations of [def-trf-polynomial-duality-affine-compatibility] hold. These use the independent coinduction boundary for adjoining $t-a$, contraction of $d(t-a)$, the ordered coordinate comparisons and the specified restriction maps. The predicate imposes no Noetherian, separatedness, flatness or existence hypothesis.
